# AI Usage Declaration

## AI Tool(s) Used

- **Claude (Anthropic)** — claude.ai

---

## Purpose of Usage

Claude was used to scaffold the full project structure, generate boilerplate code, and accelerate development of reusable components, context logic, and utility functions.
